goal: 28-team single round robins get floor-priced seasons on the page
notes: Profiled 28 teams (node --cpu-prof): every floor-priced search returned null because balancedWalk ran out of budget (heavy tail: 0.9-6.8M steps by seed on the start's own timetable) and the starter season above the gap was too rigid to move. Page step now up to 28 teams (FLOOR_PRICED_MAX_MATCHES 14). Old vs new on the same lists, 14 runs at 20-28 teams (eval/under-start.txt): no run's gap cut went down, five went up (28 teams all three seeds, 26/1, 25/2, 24/2), 381.7 s -> 335.7 s. Local verification: run_venture_tests.py league-schedule-generator 521 tests pass (244 s); venture-preflight clean; post front matter/links/similarity clean. A first cut with half the budget guided lost 22 teams' 440/58 on seed 1; caught in the A/B and fixed by the 0.1 share before merging.
